notes.title: New demo update released today!
notes.notes:
New demo update released today. 

For now use the big round pad at the top of the 'right' vive controller is for gapping stuff, the left controller is only for teleporter mode for now. Use the  trigger to teleport (when release).

Thanks for trying it out!

NOTE: This is an early stage version and still in development.
So if you have any suggestions or like to add things, please let us know.

Thanks!
